raw_response: {"diagnosis":"The v2 collector, rolled out on 2026-01-17, emits txn_ts in UTC, while legacy emits America/Chicago local time. silver_transactions mixes the two, so v2 evening transactions spill into the next day (the 36 rows on 2026-01-19 at 00:00-06:00 UTC are 18:00-24:00 local on 01-18). The v2 sample 12:11 UTC = 06:11 Chicago matches the legacy 06:00 start. The fix converts v2 timestamps to Chicago local time (UTC-6, since all data is in January/CST) before deriving txn_date.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.85,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
